api.cmd.move_elements: Move elements by an offset in metres
api.cmd.copy_elements: Copy elements by one or more offsets in metres
api.cmd.rotate_elements: Rotate elements about a point by an angle in degrees
api.cmd.mirror_elements: Mirror elements about an axis through two points
api.cmd.scale_elements: Scale elements about a point by a factor
api.cmd.array_elements: Linear or radial array of elements
api.cmd.offset_wall: Parallel copy of a wall at a distance in metres
api.cmd.split_wall: Split a wall in two at a point
api.cmd.flip_openings: Flip the hinge side or facing of doors and windows
api.cmd.create_level: Create a level at an elevation in metres
api.cmd.edit_level: Rename a level or change its elevation
api.cmd.place_rooms: Place a room in every closed region of a level
api.cmd.join_elements: Join, unjoin or switch geometry joins
api.cmd.place_footings: Place a footing under every column of a level
api.cmd.create_terrain: Create a terrain from survey points or a sloped plane
api.cmd.set_material: Set how a material looks in 3D
api.cmd.script_recipes: Read the script building blocks and recipes of freeform structures
api.cmd.generate_block: Plan a block of buildings on plots with shared site rules
api.cmd.measure_save: Save a measurement into a view
api.cmd.edit_mass: Add a history step to a mass: push, draft, shell, fillet, chamfer, offset or split
api.cmd.mass_to_family: Make a component family from a mass timeline
